title: Benchmark comparability and harness effects: research package for issue #62
status: Background research findings, not instructions and not evidence for acceptance. The record is research/market/benchmark-validation.md on PR #83.

context.question: Which benchmark differences survive controlled model-harness comparisons?
constraints: No paid runs in the initial pass

sources.title: Harness-Bench paper v2
sources.limitations: Landing metadata says 106 tasks / 5,194 trajectories; full text says 300 tasks / 20,454 combinations.

sources.title: Harness Bench website and leaderboard
sources.limitations: No run dates, snapshots or variance; per-model matrix did not render.

sources.title: Harness-Bench repository
sources.limitations: Read-only inspection; nothing executed; results not in Git.

approaches.name: Desk comparability audit
approaches.settles: Whether two published numbers can be compared at all

approaches.name: Paired statistics and power analysis
approaches.key_fact: Clustered SEs up to 3.05x naive; ~969 items to detect a 3-point gap at 80% power

approaches.name: Repeated trials and pass^k
approaches.key_fact: Single runs shift 2.2 to 6.0 points; SD above 1.5 even at temperature 0

approaches.name: Metric separation and cost frontiers
approaches.settles: Whether the mean hides incomplete delivery or cost
approaches.cost: Free if per-task scores and costs are logged

approaches.name: Fixed reference scaffold
approaches.settles: Fair model ranking; hides harness effects

approaches.name: Controlled model x harness grid
approaches.key_fact: Terminal-Bench 2.0: 6 agents x 16 models, at least 5 runs; HAL: about $40,000 for 21,730 rollouts

approaches.name: Contamination detection and fresh private tasks
approaches.settles: Whether results hold on unseen tasks
approaches.key_fact: GSM1k drops up to 13%; no method proves absence

approaches.name: Benchmark quality audit
approaches.settles: Whether tasks and graders are valid
approaches.key_fact: 7 of 10 audited agent benchmarks had task-validity flaws

approaches.name: Efficient subsampling
approaches.key_fact: Under 2% error on means, but about 12% of pairwise rankings can flip

harness_bench_facts.fact: 79 of 274 general tasks declare semantic_judge with score_role bounded_case_fallback and default_model agent; max_fallback_weight 0.06 to 0.25, median 0.10
harness_bench_facts.implication: An LLM judge (by default the evaluated model) can set part of the score, contradicting 'No LLM judge in scoring'; across models the grader differs

harness_bench_facts.fact: Per-task timeout_sec: 185 tasks at 7200 s, 44 at 3600, 17 at 2400, 28 at 1800; a runner --timeout overrides all
harness_bench_facts.implication: Budget is per task, not a single deadline

harness_bench_facts.fact: Runner defaults: temperature 1.0, thinking high, max-tokens 32768, context-window 200000, max-agent-turns 150, workers 4
harness_bench_facts.implication: Tooling defaults; S1 Appendix B.1 states published-run settings (temperature 1.0, model-specific max output, 200K context, 150 turns)

harness_bench_facts.fact: Task provenance: 212 public workflow adaptations, 42 handcrafted synthetic, 20 adapted synthetic
Every general task package ships tests/ with cases.yaml, ground_truth, reference and test_outcome.py publicly
harness_bench_facts.implication: Contamination risk for models trained after publication; exposure start date unknown
Identifies the task set even if commit links break

harness_bench_facts.fact: Public history is one commit dated 2026-10-09; 237- and 254-task locks exist but their contents are not in public history
harness_bench_facts.implication: v1 (106 tasks) contents cannot be hashed; overlap unknown

harness_bench_facts.fact: Task IDs are kept when task content is redesigned
harness_bench_facts.implication: ID matching does not prove content matching

harness_bench_facts.fact: 20,454 = 274 x 7 x 10 + 26 x 7 x 7, one run per configuration
harness_bench_facts.implication: k = 1; run variance cannot be separated from task sampling

harness_bench_facts.fact: Harness images pinned: Claude Code 2.1.220, Codex 0.145.0, Nanobot 0.3.0, OpenCode 1.18.8, Goose 1.44.0, OpenClaw 2026.5.26-slim, Hermes v2026.7.20
